summary: The bug was in the default formatting of arrays when converting to string. Before the fix, arrays were formatted without proper spacing between elements - they would render as `["node","mouth"]` instead of `["node", "mouth"]`. The root cause was that the Display implementation for Array used `self.iter().join(",")` which concatenated elements with just a comma, ignoring the need for spaces after commas in TOML array formatting. The fix introduced a new `Encode` trait that allows passing context-specific default decorations, so arrays can now apply proper formatting (space after comma for all elements except the first, which uses no leading space).
